PAGE_DESCRIPTION: Japanese radio relay server for Volumio4
RADIKO_ACCOUNT_USER_DESC: This is the username of your Radiko account
RADIKO_ACCOUNT_PASS_DESC: This is the password of your Radiko account
SERVICE_PORT_DESC: Enter the service port number (1024-65535). The default value is 9000.
BROWSE_MODE_DESC: Configure what happens when you select a station or program in the browse screen.
BROWSE_MODE_LIVE_DOC:
Configure the action when selecting a live station.
　Default: Play
BROWSE_MODE_TIMEFREE_DOC:
Configure the action when selecting a Time-Free program.
　Default: Play
RADIKO_AREAS_DESC: For AreaFree members. Choose which areas to fetch program listings for. If none are selected, all 47 areas nationwide are fetched.
TEMPO_DOC: Sets the playback speed for Time-Free programs. Does not affect live playback.
TEMPO_DESC: Sets the playback speed for Time-Free programs. Does not affect live playback.
NETWORK_DELAY_DESC: The measured delay (seconds) of live streaming. Adjust this if the time shown on the playback screen drifts noticeably. Default is 20.
ALBUMART_DESC: Configure how album art is fetched for the playback and browse screens.
ALBUMART_DOC:
Configure how album art is fetched.
　Default: Program image (fallback to station logo)
STATION_LOGO_DOC: Deletes the locally cached station logo images. They will be re-fetched the next time the plugin restarts.
TIMETABLE_DISPLAY_DESC: Configure the default date range and date/time format shown in the Time-Free timetable.
PROGRAM_PERIOD_FROM_DOC:
Number of past days (0-30) to show when opening the timetable.
　Default: 7
PROGRAM_PERIOD_TO_DOC:
Number of future days (0-6) to show when opening the timetable.
　Default: 0
TIME_FORMAT_DOC: Configure the date/time format shown on the playback screen and timetable.
